title: ‘Goodbye Cruel World’ Director and His Star, and ‘Anatomy of a Fall’ Breakout, on Exploring the “Omertà Around Bullying” (Exclusive Cannes Clip)
summary: Félix de Givry and Milo Machado-Graner discuss the Critics' Week closing film, moving from dark heaviness to more light, and why the French movie is a throwback to another period in cinema history.
